observations: Photo 0 and 1 show the front of a large solar panel with a grid of cells and a white frame.
Photo 2 and 3 show the back of the same panel, which is white and has three black MC4 connectors attached.
The panel is shown leaning against a wall in an indoor or semi-indoor setting.
Watermarks for 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' and 'Jiji' are present on all photos.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the panel itself.

risks.proof: A photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may have micro-cracks or internal damage not visible from the front.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the panel with the connectors removed.

risks.risk: The panel may be used or have degraded cells.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel showing the wattage and brand.
Photo of the back of the panel with the connectors removed.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
